description: Replay daily No Meal Left Behind upgrades from game 1.24 without changing game state. Jade Emporium grants one level. The bundle grants two levels. Both sources upgrade the lowest-level eligible meal. Ties favor the later meal in the catalogue. Upgrades stop at level 150 or the account meal level cap, whichever is lower. Read account inputs from game functions and saved meal levels. Do not run a daily reset.
target: Cooking No Meal Left Behind daily meal count, level gain, sources and next target

extractions.description: Replay daily meal selection and level gains without running a reset. Sources: docs/game-snippets/cooking/DailyResetTick.1.24.js and ../IdleonWikiBot/codefiles/idleon1.24.txt:322671-322704. Meal levels, the meal level cap, and both upgrade sources must match the retained save. No meal receives an upgrade if all eligible meals have reached level 150. The configured daily count and level gain remain enabled even when no eligible target remains.
